evidence.A: Each of the six durability mechanisms on each of four schedulers is either mapped to an IR field or marked REQUIRES-DURABLE-LOG, with a published source_anchor.
evidence.B: Replay experiment: same DAG + retry policy + scripted failures, two runs, identical stage sequence. Reverse ready-set sort is the BAD arm (sequences differ). This is measured on this estate's in-process IR sequencer, not claimed from scheduler documentation. Temporal event-history replay is UNACHIEVED.

notes.fan_out: Dynamic fan-out; out of this unit's six mechanisms.
notes.human_checkpoints: Human-in-the-loop; Temporal signals can LOSSY-map here.
notes.idempotency_key: Caller-supplied or derived key that must collapse duplicate starts.
notes.lineage: Provenance of a stage result; not a substitute for event history.
notes.loop_convergence: Loop-until; not a first-class durability mechanism here.
notes.replay_cursor: Position in an event history. Empty unless a durable log exists.
notes.resume: Continue a partially completed run; requires durable run state.
notes.roles: Who may run a stage (catalog IR).
notes.stages: Ordered work nodes; DAG topology lands here.
notes.tool_policy: Allowed tools; operator/activity bodies do not map.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: workflow history event replay (SDK re-executes workflow code; activities are not re-run)
mechanism_mappings.note: Command-event replay needs the workflow event history. This estate has no Temporal history store. Routed to architecture-lane; not faked with a JSONL file.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: WorkflowID + WorkflowIDReusePolicy on StartWorkflow
mechanism_mappings.note: The key maps to IR. Uniqueness/reuse enforcement needs the service's durable ID index.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: common.v1.RetryPolicy on activities/workflows (InitialInterval, BackoffCoefficient, MaximumAttempts)
mechanism_mappings.note: Declarative policy is an IR field. Crash-resume of attempt counters still needs a log (see deterministic_replay).

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: no BaseSensorOperator; wait is workflow.Await / signals / activity polling
mechanism_mappings.note: LOSSY: Temporal has no poke-sensor. Signal inbox is durable state → architecture-lane.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/temporalio/sdk-go@v1.35.0 workflow/doc.go:86-90 workflow.Sleep / Channel / Selector (deterministic waits)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: ScheduleSpec + ScheduleBackfill on Temporal Schedules
mechanism_mappings.note: The window maps. Completing a historical schedule range needs schedule+history durability.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: ScheduleToCloseTimeout / StartToCloseTimeout / ScheduleToStartTimeout (timeouts, not SLA-miss callbacks)
mechanism_mappings.note: Timeouts map to sla_deadline with loss: no Airflow-style SLA miss email bundled by deadline.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: DAG re-parse + TaskInstance state in metadata DB; not event-sourced workflow replay
mechanism_mappings.note: Airflow does not replay operator Python from an event log. Resume is metadata-DB state. Routed to architecture-lane. Topology still maps to IR stages (see replay experiment for the transferable subset).
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/apache/airflow@2.10.4 airflow/models/baseoperator.py:606-614 retries (state lives on TaskInstance, not in the operator class)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: identity = dag_id + task_id + run_id; no caller-supplied idempotency_key
mechanism_mappings.note: Derived identity maps LOSSY onto idempotency_key. Operators are documented as should-be-idempotent by convention, not by a key API.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/apache/airflow@2.10.4 airflow/models/baseoperator.py (task_id / dag_id identity; no idempotency_key parameter on BaseOperator.__init__)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: retries, retry_delay, retry_exponential_backoff, max_retry_delay
mechanism_mappings.note: Policy maps onto IR retries. Attempt persistence is the metadata DB (architecture-lane via deterministic_replay row).

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: BaseSensorOperator poke/reschedule, poke_interval, timeout, exponential_backoff
mechanism_mappings.note: Sensor wait-until is an IR gate. poke mode holding a worker slot is a runtime, not an IR field.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/apache/airflow@2.10.4 airflow/sensors/base.py BaseSensorOperator (mode in {poke, reschedule}, poke())

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: airflow dags backfill over logical dates / data intervals
mechanism_mappings.note: The window maps. Which intervals already succeeded is metadata-DB state.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/apache/airflow@2.10.4 airflow/cli/commands/dag_command.py backfill; logical_date range on DagRun

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: sla timedelta on BaseOperator; SLA miss email + DB record
mechanism_mappings.note: Deadline maps. Miss recording/email is scheduler+DB — architecture-lane, not a side file.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: flow-run / task-run state in the Prefect API DB; result cache is not Temporal replay
mechanism_mappings.note: Prefect retries a task; it does not re-execute a deterministic workflow function against recorded commands. Routed to architecture-lane.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect@3.1.11 src/prefect/tasks.py (task run state + cache_key_fn; no event-history replay API)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: idempotency_key on run_deployment / arun_deployment / create_flow_run
mechanism_mappings.note: The parameter maps. Collapsing duplicate starts needs the API's durable run index.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: retries, retry_delay_seconds (number, list, or callable exponential helper)
mechanism_mappings.note: Policy maps onto IR retries. Worked replay on this estate exercises this mapping.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: Prefect 3 automations/triggers; no Airflow BaseSensorOperator in core 3.1.11
mechanism_mappings.note: LOSSY: wait-until can be an IR gate; Prefect's automation engine is not that class.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect@3.1.11 (no src/prefect/sensors.py equivalent to Airflow BaseSensorOperator)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: no Airflow-style DAG logical_date backfill in core 3.1.11
mechanism_mappings.note: LOSSY: a date window can be stored on IR; Prefect 3.1.11 core does not ship Airflow backfill.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: timeout_seconds on Task (hard timeout, not SLA-miss callback)
mechanism_mappings.note: LOSSY: timeout ≠ SLA miss. Prefect Cloud SLA APIs are out of this pinned core tag.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: run event log / instance run storage; ops are not Temporal-style history-replayed functions
mechanism_mappings.note: Re-execution from failure uses instance storage. Routed to architecture-lane.
mechanism_mappings.source_anchor: github.com/dagster-io/dagster@1.9.6 python_modules/dagster/dagster/_core/definitions/policy.py RetryPolicy (retry is in-run; history is instance storage)

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: run_key on RunRequest / sensor RunRequest
mechanism_mappings.note: run_key maps. Dedup of runs needs instance run storage.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: RetryPolicy(max_retries, delay, backoff=LINEAR|EXPONENTIAL, jitter)
mechanism_mappings.note: Policy maps. Jitter is NON-DETERMINISTIC if used; the worked replay uses delay without jitter.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: @sensor / SensorDefinition yielding RunRequest | SkipReason
mechanism_mappings.note: Evaluation cursor is instance state; the wait-until shape is an IR gate.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: partition backfills / BackfillPolicy on assets
mechanism_mappings.note: The window/policy maps. Completed partition materialisations are instance storage.

mechanism_mappings.native_construct: FreshnessPolicy / freshness checks (asset freshness, not Airflow task SLA)
mechanism_mappings.note: LOSSY: freshness is not a per-op SLA miss. Closest IR field is sla_deadline with that caveat.

question_or_target: Implementation target: extract the durability mechanisms these four schedulers provide - deterministic replay, idempotency keys, retry/backoff policy, sensors, backfill, task-level SLA - into IR fields, and state which require a durable execution log this estate does not have.
